script_text: Listen closely, dear Water sign, because your ruling planet Neptune whispers a secret this week. On Monday, Mars enters your 11th House, igniting friendships that shift your career path upward. Tuesday, Moon opposes your sign, heightening sensitivity. By Wednesday, Venus sextile Mars brings unexpected romance through a mutual friend in your 9th House. The turning point arrives Thursday when Jupiter trines your money house Saturn, unlocking a fresh income stream from your 2nd House. Late week, the Sun squares Pluto in your 12th House, demanding you release old fears before you enjoy a romantic dinner this coming Sunday. Wednesday is truly your power day because Venus brings emotional clarity to your 9th House. Friday is your hardest day because the Sun confronts hidden enemies in your 12th. Trust your deep inner intuition today and close every loose financial contract. Please follow me for daily updates.
